name: test-buddy
description: Test Buddy shows a practice quiz or a short lesson as an interactive screen inside the chat, for Finnish school subjects. Choose the grade that matches the difficulty of your material, for example grade 4.

interface.longDescription: Practise school subjects with an interactive quiz of up to ten questions per round (longer practice runs in rounds), or learn a topic with a short lesson of cards, quick checks and simple visuals, all shown inside the chat. Name a topic and a grade (for example grade 4) or upload your material. Study Helper offers simpler explanations, a hint before you answer, the reason why, another way to explain a wrong answer, and an extra example on lesson cards. Questions and lessons are made by AI and are not official exam content: check them against your textbook. The quiz or lesson you start (topic and questions) is sent to the plugin's server to display the screen.
